counting_rule: EXCLUDED_FROM_PROJECT_SUBSTANTIVE_AND_AUTHORIAL_COUNTS; may be counted separately as external_under_test

comparators.statement: Quartz piezoelectricity can contribute to stress-related electromagnetic signals in suitably oriented/conductive geological settings.
comparators.boundary: not universal earthquake precursor and not sole fracture-emission mechanism

comparators.statement: Fracture/contact electrification can contribute to synchronized electrical, optical or radio emissions during material failure.
Stress-activated positive-hole charge carriers may contribute to luminous/high-frequency emissions in stressed rocks.
comparators.boundary: does not establish explanation for every earthquake light or prediction

comparators.statement: Electrokinetic fluid/charge transport may contribute to geophysical electromagnetic observations under appropriate porous-flow conditions.
comparators.boundary: must be distinguished from quartz and other charge mechanisms

comparators.statement: Solar/ionospheric conductivity changes can modulate electromagnetic/ELF observations that might otherwise be misattributed to local geology.
comparators.boundary: solar modulation is not identity with a local geophysical source

comparators.statement: Instrumental, power-grid, weather or anthropogenic effects can explain some candidate geophysical electromagnetic anomalies.
comparators.boundary: requires independent-station, grid and weather controls

note: The 13 literature entries are evidence/reference records, not 13 additional owned hypotheses. The six mechanism comparators are reported separately and excluded from the 39-ID project-substantive frontier unless a distinct RAFAELIA proposition about them is later formalized.
invariant: external scientific mechanisms remain attributed to external literature and cannot inflate authorial originality counts
